0022600130.text: The San Antonio Spurs, 1-2 and 0-2 at home, host the 0-2 Sacramento Kings in the fourth game of the Spurs' season, with San Antonio sitting 3rd in the Southwest and 11th in the West after a win in its last outing. Sacramento is on a two-game losing streak and sits 4th in the Pacific and 14th in the West. Out for the Spurs are Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), while the Kings are without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Spurs swept all three games against Sacramento in 2025-26, including a 132-104 win in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
